title: General Kakeya Dimension Conjecture
exact_target: Let $E\subset\mathbb R^n$, and let $D$ be the set of directions in which $E$ contains a unit line segment. If $D\neq\varnothing$, must $\dim_{\mathrm H}E\geq\dim_{\mathrm H}D+1$?
